verdictEs: Just-Wiped para encontrar wipe fresco rápido sin overhead. BattleMetrics cuando necesitas tracking, alertas o RCON remoto.
verdictEn: Just-Wiped to find a fresh wipe fast with no overhead. BattleMetrics when you need tracking, alerts, or remote RCON.

useCases.labelEs: Force wipe day, encontrar server fresco rápido
useCases.labelEn: Force wipe day, find a fresh server fast
useCases.reasonEs: Just-Wiped tiene filter "Wiped in last 1h" como primary CTA. BattleMetrics requiere combinar filtros para llegar al mismo resultado.
useCases.reasonEn: Just-Wiped has "Wiped in last 1h" as primary CTA. BattleMetrics requires combining filters to reach the same result.

useCases.labelEs: Trackear cuándo entra al server un player específico
useCases.labelEn: Track when a specific player logs into the server
useCases.reasonEs: BattleMetrics tiene Watch lists, alertas push/email, history de sessions por player. Just-Wiped no tiene esa funcionalidad.
useCases.reasonEn: BattleMetrics has watch lists, push/email alerts, per-player session history. Just-Wiped doesn't have that functionality.

useCases.labelEs: Admin remoto via RCON desde móvil
useCases.labelEn: Remote admin via RCON from mobile
useCases.reasonEs: BattleMetrics expone RCON via web browser/mobile sin necesidad de loguear al cliente. Just-Wiped no admin features.
useCases.reasonEn: BattleMetrics exposes RCON via web browser/mobile without logging into the client. Just-Wiped has no admin features.

useCases.labelEs: Encontrar weekly server con tu wipe schedule preferido
useCases.labelEn: Find a weekly server with your preferred wipe schedule
useCases.reasonEs: Just-Wiped filtra por wipe schedule (weekly Tuesdays, biweekly Thursdays) directo. BattleMetrics cubre menos esa axis.
useCases.reasonEn: Just-Wiped filters by wipe schedule (weekly Tuesdays, biweekly Thursdays) directly. BattleMetrics covers that axis less well.

useCases.labelEs: Alertas cuando tu server cae o un slot abre
useCases.labelEn: Alerts when your server goes down or a slot opens
useCases.reasonEs: BattleMetrics tiene sistema de alertas configurables con Discord webhooks. Just-Wiped no tiene alertas — solo browser.
useCases.reasonEn: BattleMetrics has configurable alerts with Discord webhooks. Just-Wiped has no alerts — only browsing.
